author: GoPro
description:
3 world record attempts. One unforgettable night.

@RecordBreakersCo took over Revel Surf Park in Mesa, Arizona for a full day of action featuring surfing, skateboarding, BMX, moto, and trophy trucks — all leading up to the main event at sunset.

The event featured three massive world records:

🏍️ @raha sent it 300 feet over the Revel Surf Pool into the world’s largest 30ft moto quarter pipe, breaking the high-air world record and reaching heights of 90ft.

🏁 Blake Wilkey launched his Trophy Truck VW Bug an incredible 214ft, showcasing just how far the limits of these trucks can be pushed.

🛻 Paul Fisher set the new record for the longest distance jump in a steel cab truck at 209 ft.

Thousands showed up for an unforgettable night of progression, massive sends, and history in the making.
